aiReview.overallSummary: The UI quality suite executes successfully across most key marketing, authentication, and dashboard navigation routes, demonstrating clean layout design and robust component structure. However, test 11 failed due to a timeout because the clinical intelligence route remains stuck in a loading state ('Connecting evidence…') during test execution, pointing to a state handling issue or asynchronous data fetch delay.

strengths: Clear value proposition and visual hierarchy on the landing page
Prominent and accessible primary CTA ('Launch Workspace')
reviews.reviewNotes: Landing page experience is well-structured and functional.

strengths: Clean sign-in interface with visible form controls and clear helper text
reviews.reviewNotes: Auth page correctly exposes usable controls.

strengths: Good accessibility adherence with keyboard focusable form inputs and buttons
reviews.reviewNotes: Keyboard navigation functions as expected on the auth form.

strengths: Comprehensive dashboard sidebar navigation covering all core application routes
reviews.reviewNotes: Application shell renders core navigation properly.

strengths: Review queue route mounts successfully with proper layout and state indicators
Rich clinical workspace layout offering direct entry points into specialized workflows
reviews.reviewNotes: Clinical workspace route renders all required sub-modules.

strengths: Analytics route loads cleanly within the dashboard layout shell
Reports view presents clear filters, export capabilities, and tabular summary data
reviews.reviewNotes: Reports interface is fully realized and informative.

strengths: Settings page provides logical grouping for profile, password management, and workspace access
reviews.reviewNotes: Settings route loads with clear controls.

strengths: Initial loading state correctly communicates background evidence connection

issues.issue: Clinical intelligence view remains stuck in loading state ('Connecting evidence…') during test execution, causing test timeout when searching for priority findings heading.
issues.evidence: Test 11 failed with timeout waiting for getByRole('heading', { name: /priority findings/i }); screenshot shows persistent loading spinner.

recommendations.recommendation: Optimize the asynchronous evidence-fetching lifecycle or add a timeout fallback state on the clinical intelligence route so users are not indefinitely blocked on loading indicators.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Prevents UI lockups and ensures core intelligence sections render reliably.

reviews.reviewNotes: Although test 12 eventually succeeds after a long delay, test 11 fails due to the timeout. The prolonged loading sequence represents a flow/state handling bottleneck.

strengths: Extremely thorough, well-formatted evidence-backed clinical intelligence review output
Clear separation of decision readiness, critical findings, missing evidence, and coordinator action plans
Prominent reviewer disclaimers ensuring proper human-in-the-loop oversight
reviews.reviewNotes: Once loaded, the clinical intelligence view provides exceptional analytical depth and traceability.
